figurative_meaning_en: The entire universe is one and indivisible
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার দর্শন করলে মনে হয় একমেব অদ্বিতীয়ম সত্য।
আধ্যাত্মিক জ্ঞানে বিশ্বকে একমেব অদ্বিতীয়ম হিসেবে দেখা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: Upon seeing it, one realizes the truth of 'one without a second'.
In spiritual knowledge, the universe is perceived as one and indivisible.
history: References Arjuna's vision of the universal form (Vishvarupa Darshana) of Lord Krishna in the Bhagavad Gita, symbolizing the oneness of the cosmos.
note: This phrase originates from Sanskrit scriptures and is used in Bengali contexts to denote ultimate unity in Hindu philosophy.
